subject.title: gateway tool not available to external-provider agent sessions

question: Should an owner/admin xAI/Grok agent session with explicit `alsoAllow: ["gateway"]` expose the `gateway` tool, or is the provider/session mode meant to hide it?
rationale: The documented config path suggests explicit allow policy should work, but exposing `gateway` crosses a security-sensitive control-plane boundary and needs maintainer intent before an automated repair.

options.title: Support explicit owner allow
options.body: Treat `gateway` as available to owner/admin external-provider sessions when explicitly allowed, then require focused xAI/Grok inventory proof and regression coverage.

options.title: Document intentional restriction
options.body: If external-provider sessions must never expose `gateway`, document the restriction and add a diagnostic so users do not chase a missing config knob.

options.title: Pause for live repro only
options.body: Keep the behavior undecided until a maintainer or reporter captures a current-main xAI/Grok inventory run showing where `gateway` is filtered.

recommendation.title: Support explicit owner allow
recommendation.body: Treat `gateway` as available to owner/admin external-provider sessions when explicitly allowed, then require focused xAI/Grok inventory proof and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent capability-profile and tool-inventory work makes this the closest available owner for deciding the security-sensitive provider/tool policy boundary.
